name: cvc5_shells_crosscheck
description: cvc5 independent cross-check of z3 UNSAT claims from sim_torch_constraint_shells_v2. Three constraint shell claims re-proved in both z3 (QF_LRA/QF_NRA) and cvc5 (QF_LRA/QF_NRA). SyGuS synthesis attempted for admissible Bloch ball boundary generator.
claims_cross_checked: Channel contraction > 1 UNSAT (L4_Composition shell, CPTP constraint)
Qubit entropy > log(2) UNSAT (L5/L6 entropy shell upper bound)

pyg.reason: probe operates on density matrices; graph-level message passing architectures are outside this probe's scope

z3.reason: primary UNSAT solver; claims sourced from v2

sympy.reason: not needed -- exact rational arithmetic via Fraction

clifford.reason: all geometric operations use torch matrix algebra; Clifford rotor computation is outside this probe's scope

geomstats.reason: geometry handled with analytic expressions; Riemannian manifold library is outside this probe's scope

e3nn.reason: SO(3)-equivariant neural networks are outside this probe's scope; probe uses direct operator application

rustworkx.reason: probe uses matrix operations rather than graph traversal; rustworkx is outside this probe's scope

xgi.reason: probe uses standard matrix operations; hypergraph computation is outside this probe's scope

toponetx.reason: probe uses standard linear algebra; chain complex computation is outside this probe's scope

gudhi.reason: probe uses analytic methods; persistent homology library is outside this probe's scope

claim1_bloch_norm_gt1_unsat.description: Bloch vector norm > 1 is impossible for any valid density matrix

claim2_channel_contraction_gt1_unsat.description: CPTP channel contraction factor > 1 is impossible (p in [0,1] => lam=1-p in [0,1])

claim3_entropy_gt_log2_unsat.description: Qubit entropy exceeding log(2) is impossible (bounded maximum entropy)

claim1_bloch_norm_gt1_sat_if_unconstrain.description: r in [0,2] with r > 1 is SAT (constraint dropped)

claim3_entropy_gt_log2_sat_if_unbounded.description: s in [0,2] with s > log(2) is SAT (physical upper bound removed)

claim1_bloch_norm_exactly_1_sat.description: Bloch norm = 1 is SAT (pure state at sphere boundary)

claim3_entropy_at_log2_sat.description: Entropy in [log2_lower, log2_upper] is SAT (maximally mixed state)

sygus_synthesis.note: SyGuS found minimal generator for Bloch ball boundary
